title: ClearPath Tier Rate Discount on Time-and-Materials Statements of Work
content:
For a time-and-materials statement of work of Professional Services Projects, the managed-services component of the rate discount locked at signature is decided by the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement as it stands on the signature date.

## Clause

The managed-services component of the rate discount locked at signature is the class ClearPath rate discount plus 2.5 percentage points for a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, the class ClearPath rate discount for a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Professional tier, and nothing for any other client, including one whose only ClearPath agreements are closed, cancelled, suspended, under notice or on a lower tier.

| Client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement | Managed-services component |
|---|---|
| in active status on ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | the class ClearPath rate discount plus 2.5 percentage points |
| in active status on ClearPath Professional | the class ClearPath rate discount |
| in active status on ClearPath Monitor, ClearPath Essentials or ClearPath Standard | nothing |
| closed, cancelled, suspended or under notice only, or no ClearPath agreement | nothing |

## The component by engagement class

The class ClearPath rate discount is the figure on the time-and-materials rate card of the engagement's class. For the classes that may be signed on time and materials it gives:

| Engagement class | Class ClearPath rate discount | Active on Premier or Enterprise | Active on Professional |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quick Start Project | 5.0 | 7.5 | 5.0 |
| Standard Project | 5.0 | 7.5 | 5.0 |
| Advanced Project | 7.5 | 10.0 | 7.5 |
| Major Project | 7.5 | 10.0 | 7.5 |
| Strategic Program | 10.0 | 12.5 | 10.0 |

Hypothetical illustration: a client whose ClearPath agreement on the ClearPath Enterprise tier is in suspended status on the signature date earns nothing under this clause, because the agreement is not in active status.
